title: Streets Full of Children
old_p1: Long ago, Jerusalem was broken, and many people had to go far away. Zechariah told of a happy day to come.
The Lord said, “I will live in Jerusalem.” His mountain there would be called the holy mountain. Holy means very special to Heavenly Father.
Old men and old women would be in the streets, each with a walking stick because they were so old.
old_p2: And the streets would be full of boys and girls playing! Zechariah used that picture to show how a holy city feels: safe, kind and happy, for young and old.
Your home can feel like that city too. Tonight, think of one kind thing you can do tomorrow for a grandma, grandpa or friend.
p1: Once, Jerusalem had been broken, and many families had gone far away. But the Lord gave Zechariah a picture of happier days ahead.

Imagine the streets filled with neighbors again. Grandmothers and grandfathers sit outside, resting with their walking sticks. The city is peaceful enough for them to stay and enjoy the sunshine. The Lord promises to be with His people.
p2: And listen! There are children laughing in the streets. Little feet patter over the stones as boys and girls play together. Young and old have a place to belong. What a lovely city!

Zechariah's picture shows a place full of kindness and peace. We can help make our own homes feel that way. Maybe tomorrow you can hold a grandparent's hand, play kindly with a friend, or help someone who needs you.
note: Levi, 20 Nov 2026 ("Match up the story lantern stories with the published book"): p1 and p2 are the story words AS PRINTED in the published December book (We Have Waited for Him, on Amazon), first and second story page, word for word, so the Lantern, the app's Books page and the book a family bought read the same. The Christian edition reads God for Heavenly Father; p2_christian only where the printed words are Latter-day Saint teaching. The 29 Oct picture-book rewrite is kept as rewrite_p1/rewrite_p2.
rewrite_p1: Many people had lived far away from Jerusalem. Now some had come home. Zechariah told them about a happy day to come.
“I will come back and live in Jerusalem,” said the Lord. It would be a city of truth. His mountain there would be holy, very special to Heavenly Father.
There would be old men and old women in the streets again. Each would hold a walking stick, because they were so old.
rewrite_p2: And the streets would be full of boys and girls playing! Young and old would be safe and happy together.
Your home can feel like that city too. Tonight, think of a kind thing to do for a grandma, grandpa or friend.
